en: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS` so a repository's `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` can no longer set it; shell, user and managed settings still can
zh: 变更 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS`：仓库的 `.claude/settings.json` 或 `.claude/settings.local.json` 不再能设置它；shell、用户和托管设置仍可设置
